args.title: Handle trailing carriage returns in parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update parser.ts to handle trailing carriage returns (CRLF / \r) when popping empty lines at the end of the file.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser currently checks `lines[lines.length - 1] === ""` to pop empty lines at the end of files, but files ending with CRLF leave a trailing `\r` instead of an empty string. Updating the parser to handle trailing carriage returns will ensure files ending with CRLF pass row shape validation correctly.
